intentional_p0_corrections.contract: Reject unsafe host, remote directory, executable, SSH/SCP word, Bash payload, and SBATCH directive inputs before crossing process boundaries.
Forward tilts, azimuths, thickness, and set-default through every remote slice.
Validate proposed catalog and provenance before atomic replacement; failed writes leave both unchanged.
Value flags require --set; numeric domains are validated; zero is preserved only where documented.
Stale material-catalog golden emits stderr warning after successful mutation.
Follow-log failures are nonzero, interruption is 130, and partial pull failures remain failures even when some items succeed.
Command succeeds only from source checkout and fails clearly from installed wheel.
Human presentation sanitizes controls and machine framing uses versioned base64 fields.

root.description: Coherent X-ray radiation (PXR + coherent bremsstrahlung) toolkit.
root.help:
usage: cxr [-h] [--version]
           {scan,blaze,export,analyze,slim,rebrem,reline,archive,restore,archives,union,remote,line-grid,check,check-config} ...

Coherent X-ray radiation (PXR + coherent bremsstrahlung) toolkit.

positional arguments:
  {scan,blaze,export,analyze,slim,rebrem,reline,archive,restore,archives,union,remote,line-grid,check,check-config}
    scan                run one material's MC sweep -> checkpoint
    blaze               run one material's blazed-crystal MC sweep -> _blazed
                        checkpoint
    export              render notebooks/analysis_app.py ->
                        results/<stem>.html
    analyze             launch notebooks/analysis_app.py (marimo run/edit)
    slim                shrink a checkpoint pickle for transfer
    rebrem              recompute ONLY the brem background of existing
                        checkpoints (new Ne_brem / grid spacing); line spectra
                        untouched
    reline              recompute ONLY the line spectra of existing
                        checkpoints (new line grid / Ne); brem untouched
    archive             copy an active checkpoint to the long-term shelf
    restore             copy an archived checkpoint back to the active slot
    archives            list the long-term shelf
    union               merge an archived checkpoint into the active slot
    remote              [dev] push code + run/manage MC sweeps on a remote GPU
                        box over ssh
    line-grid           derive/apply per-material line-grid bounds (local or
                        on qlmc)
    check               launch notebooks/validation_app.py (marimo run/edit),
                        or --export its figures
    check-config        validate the bundled material catalog or an explicit
                        full catalog TOML

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

    scan                sync code, submit sweep(s), wait, and pull checkpoints
    rebrem              recompute brem-only in the box's checkpoints (GPU),

    reline              recompute line-only in the box's checkpoints (GPU),

                        recent log

                        job

                        killed jobs (dry preview unless --yes)
    pull                fetch one or more existing checkpoints from the box
    clear               delete a material's accumulated checkpoints on the
                        box, or --all
    sync                push the current code to the box only
    check               run the Zhai reproduction + supplementary MC on the
                        box, pull caches back
